_comment: WazeAPI coverage boxes. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH — it is version-controlled,
because the box list is what the monthly bill is computed from and a change to it is
a change of what the deployment watches.
Format: [name, 'south,west', 'north,east'] — the relay's own tile format.
Override for a one-off test with WAZEAPI_TILES in the relay's .env (env wins), but a
change that is meant to last belongs here so it has a diff, an author and a date.
Cost: one request per box per poll. At the 30-minute interval below that is
48 requests/box/day -> $2.88 per box per month at $0.0020/request.
15 boxes = 21,600 requests = $43.20/month (or $38.20 on the Pro plan, which covers
20,000 and bills the overflow at the same $0.0020).
HISTORY worth keeping: Box Hill East -> 'Box Hill / Doncaster' and Ringwood ->
Bayswater (2026-09-18) removed a 6.7 x 7.0 km overlap with the Glen Waverley box,
which was the box containing Mulgrave. Inner South and Inner North-West were added the
same day to close the two largest gaps in the inner ring.
